actions.name: Find events
actions.description: Finds the events on one calendar that overlap a time window, earliest first, 25 a page, with each repeating event shown as its single occurrences. Times are read in your calendar's time zone, which the answer names.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars, or primary for your own calendar.

from.description: The start of the window, as a local wall time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS in your calendar's time zone.

to.description: The end of the window, as a local wall time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS in your calendar's time zone.

q.description: Words every event found holds, in its title, description, place or guests.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the page before, for the next page.

actions.name: Get event details
actions.description: Reads one event: its times, place, description (cut at 4,000 characters), organizer, up to 100 guests with their answers, how it repeats and its video call link.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars, or primary for your own calendar.

eventId.description: The event id, as Find events or Get event details gives it.

actions.name: List my calendars
actions.description: Lists the calendars on your list, 50 a page, with each one's id (which the other Calendar actions take), name, your access and its time zone.

pageToken.description: nextPageToken from the page before, for the next page.

actions.name: Find free time
actions.description: Finds the free blocks of at least minMinutes in a time window, across up to 20 calendars, from their busy times. A calendar Google cannot read never shows as free. Blocks are in UTC; the answer names your time zone.

from.description: The start of the window, as a local wall time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS in your calendar's time zone.

to.description: The end of the window, as a local wall time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS in your calendar's time zone.

calendars.description: The calendars to check: ids from List my calendars, or primary.

minMinutes.description: The shortest free block worth showing, in minutes.

actions.name: Create event
actions.description: Creates one event: timed, from local start and end times in your calendar's time zone, or all day, from a first day and a number of days. It may repeat (one RRULE line), invite guests and add a Google Meet link. Google emails people only as notify says.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars, or primary for your own calendar.

kind.description: timed takes start and end, and no date or days; all-day takes date and days, and no start or end.

start.description: The start of a timed event, as a local wall time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS in your calendar's time zone.

end.description: The end of a timed event, as a local wall time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS in your calendar's time zone.

date.description: The first day of an all-day event, YYYY-MM-DD.

days.description: How many days an all-day event lasts.

recurrence.description: How it repeats: one RRULE line, such as RRULE:FREQ=WEEKLY;COUNT=3.

meet.description: true adds a Google Meet video call.

notify.description: Who Google emails about this change: none (nobody), externalOnly (guests outside your organization) or all guests.

actions.name: Quick add
actions.description: Creates one event from a line of text, such as "Lunch on 2026-11-02 at 12pm to 1pm"; Google reads the title, date and time from it in your calendar's time zone. The answer shows the times Google read. It invites nobody: use Create event for guests.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars, or primary for your own calendar.

text.description: The line of text Google reads.

notify.description: Who Google emails about this change: none (nobody), externalOnly (guests outside your organization) or all guests.

expr.const: Google reads the date and time from the text, in your calendar's time zone.

actions.name: Update or reschedule
actions.description: Changes the title, description, place or times of one event, sending only what you give, and only if the event is still the version read first. New times are local wall times in your calendar's time zone.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars, or primary for your own calendar.

eventId.description: The event id, as Find events or Get event details gives it.

start.description: The new start, as a local wall time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS in your calendar's time zone.

end.description: The new end, as a local wall time YYYY-MM-DDTHH:MM:SS in your calendar's time zone.

notify.description: Who Google emails about this change: none (nobody), externalOnly (guests outside your organization) or all guests.

actions.name: Invite or remove guests
actions.description: Invites and removes guests of one event, keeping every other guest and their answers as they are. It never removes the organizer or you, and acts only if the event is still the version read first.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars, or primary for your own calendar.

eventId.description: The event id, as Find events or Get event details gives it.

notify.description: Who Google emails about this change: none (nobody), externalOnly (guests outside your organization) or all guests.

actions.name: Respond to an invitation
actions.description: Answers an invitation on your calendar: accepted, declined or tentative. It sends only your own guest entry, and refuses when you are not a guest of the event.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars, or primary for your own calendar.

eventId.description: The event id, as Find events or Get event details gives it.

notify.description: Who Google emails about this change: none (nobody), externalOnly (guests outside your organization) or all guests.

actions.name: Cancel or delete event
actions.description: Cancels an event you organize, or removes an invitation from your calendar. To tell an organizer you will not come, use Respond to an invitation with declined.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars, or primary for your own calendar.

eventId.description: The event id, as Find events or Get event details gives it.

notify.description: Who Google emails about this change: none (nobody), externalOnly (guests outside your organization) or all guests.

expr.const: Deleting an invitation removes it from your calendar only. To tell the organizer, use Respond to an invitation with declined.

actions.name: Move event
actions.description: Moves an event you organize to another of your calendars, keeping its id. Only ordinary events move: focus time, out of office and working location events are refused.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars, or primary for your own calendar.

eventId.description: The event id, as Find events or Get event details gives it.

destination.description: The calendar to move it to: an id from List my calendars.

notify.description: Who Google emails about this change: none (nobody), externalOnly (guests outside your organization) or all guests.

actions.name: Create a calendar
actions.description: Creates a new calendar you own, in your time zone unless you name another IANA zone such as America/Toronto.

timeZone.description: An IANA time zone, such as America/Toronto.

actions.name: Stop sharing a calendar
actions.description: Removes one sharing rule of a calendar you own, so that person or group no longer sees it. It never removes an owner's rule.

calendarId.description: The calendar: an id from List my calendars, or primary for your own calendar.

ruleId.description: The sharing rule, such as user:someone@example.com.
